_comment: Simplified Chinese (Mainland China) texts for the German table era_moments. Keys are the English text; keys with %s or %d are patterns. Kept by hand; check with python3 tools/i18n/check_lang.py zh_CN.

strings.Detail: 180 lines become 270, figures gr: 细节：180行变为270行，人物变大
strings.Detail: every tile gets its own colours: 细节：每块图块都有自己的颜色
strings.Detail: figures breathe, the view moves: 细节：人物会呼吸，视角会移动
由Chimora团队用四种墨水绘制。
strings.Frames: redrawn as bevelled plates: 边框：重绘为斜边金属板
strings.Most of the people who helped you lied a: 帮过你的人，大多在为什么帮你这件事上撒了谎。
strings.Palette: light and glow on every colour: 调色板：每种颜色都有光影与辉光
strings.Quillmarch signed, sealed and sold you t: Quillmarch把你签了字、盖了章，卖了两次。
strings.So did your friends. You kept walking an: 你的朋友们也一样。你还是继续往前走了。
strings.Sound: a second voice and an echo join: 声音：加入第二声部与回声
strings.Sound: bell tones in a wide room: 声音：宽阔空间中的钟声音色
strings.Sound: music in layers that follow you: 声音：随你而动的多层音乐
strings.Sound: sampled voices and a room: 声音：采样人声与空间混响
小字条款才是诚实的部分。
strings.Up close, everyone had a price and a nic: 凑近了看，每个人都有个价码和一副好笑容。
strings.You were only cheated by people you like: 骗你的，全是你喜欢的人。
